# Ready order candidate: Rust macOS native window lane

**Status:** candidate for independent coordinator review; no implementation is authorized by this artifact. **Target:** Apple Silicon macOS 13+. **Dependencies:** accepted `vexel-platform-apple` MainThread and `guard_native_call`; audited pins already in its manifest; existing `vexel-ui` geometry/input/value types. New root kernel contract work is not a peer dependency. No new dependency, manifest change, C/ObjC shim, unsupported OS backend, GPL code, or generic second roadmap.

## Objective and public contract

Port the complete native window/lifecycle/geometry/input/IME/tick/queue/teardown lane enumerated in `parity-map.json` from `src/platform/platform_window.h` and the five `src/platform/macos/platform_window*.m` modules. Preserve observable contracts and limits while replacing public C pointers/fixed buffers with Rust-owned values. Keep all native owners private to `vexel-platform-apple`; no Objective-C type or pointer crosses the public API.

Proposed signatures (names may be module-qualified, semantics are fixed):

```rust
pub struct NativeApp { /* private, !Send + !Sync */ }
pub struct Window { /* private retained AppKit owner, !Send + !Sync */ }
pub struct WindowId { pub slot: u32, pub generation: u32 }
pub struct WindowConfig { pub title: String, pub width_points: u32,
    pub height_points: u32, pub resizable: bool, pub initially_hidden: bool }
pub enum WindowEvent { Open, Focus(bool), Resize{points: Size, pixels: SizeU32},
    BackingScaleChanged{scale: f64, pixels: SizeU32}, KeyDown{code:u16, modifiers:Modifiers},
    KeyUp{code:u16, modifiers:Modifiers}, Pointer(PointerEvent), Scroll(ScrollEvent),
    Magnify{at:Point, amount:f64}, TextCommitted(String), Composition(Composition),
    CloseRequested, AnimationTick{monotonic_seconds:f64}, QueueFault(QueueFault) }
pub fn NativeApp::start(mt: MainThread) -> Result<Self, WindowError>;
pub fn NativeApp::create_window(&mut self, config: WindowConfig)
    -> Result<(WindowId, Window), WindowError>;
pub fn Window::set_title(&mut self, title: String) -> Result<(), WindowError>;
pub fn Window::set_visible(&mut self, visible: bool) -> Result<(), WindowError>;
pub fn Window::resize(&mut self, size: Size) -> Result<(), WindowError>;
pub fn Window::content_screen_origin(&self) -> Result<Point, WindowError>;
pub fn Window::set_cursor(&mut self, cursor: Cursor) -> Result<(), WindowError>;
pub fn Window::request_ticks(&mut self, enabled: bool) -> Result<(), WindowError>;
pub fn NativeApp::poll_events(&mut self, window: WindowId, max: NonZeroUsize)
    -> Result<Vec<WindowEvent>, WindowError>;
pub fn Window::destroy(self) -> Result<(), WindowError>;
pub fn NativeApp::shutdown(self) -> Result<(), WindowError>;
```

`MainThread::acquire()` is the only safe acquisition path. Every public native operation takes/retains the capability through its owner. `NativeApp`, `Window`, subscriptions, and route state are main-thread-only. Config title is nonempty valid Rust UTF-8 (no NUL), <=1,024 bytes; point dimensions 1..=4,096; coordinates/deltas finite and bounded. Event paths (only in later file gate) <=4,095 bytes. Text payload <=64 KiB; total pending owned payload <=1 MiB; event queue <=256. Checked arithmetic on point-to-pixel conversion; use rounded extents, never integer-truncate scale. Reject nonintegral or out-of-range backing scale until the accepted UI contract is extended (UI currently accepts integer 1..=3).

## File scope and ownership

Allowed production additions: `rust/crates/vexel-platform-apple/src/native_window/{mod.rs,types.rs,app.rs,window.rs,geometry.rs,input.rs,ime.rs,queue.rs,ticks.rs,teardown.rs}` and a single `mod native_window`/re-export addition to that crate's `src/lib.rs`. No manifest/lock changes. Allowed focused tests: `rust/crates/vexel-platform-apple/tests/native_window.rs` and private module unit tests colocated in these new files. Protected: every other Rust crate/source, all manifests/config/lockfiles, `src/`, headers, existing tests, ADR/docs/work orders/state/ledgers, existing artifacts, root contract work, and generated/build/cache output. Keep each new production module <800 lines.

Map retained Cocoa owners with `Retained<T>`; create results own, getters remain borrowed unless retained before escape. `Window` owns native window/view/delegate registration, queue, generation token, optional timer and input reset state. Callback closures carry only `Weak<RouteState>` + `{slot,generation}` and bounded owned data. Invalidate generation/weak route first during teardown, then stop timer/wake source, cancel or detach callback sources, clear delegate/view routes, drain/release events and native owners. Stale callbacks/completions are ignored by generation. Do not retain native pointers in public values.

## Native behavior

**Startup/window:** `NativeApp::start` acquires shared `NSApplication`, regular activation policy, finish launch, and establishes main run-loop ownership. `create_window` validates all fields before native allocation; on any native failure, release partial objects and publish no handle. Use baseline window/style/backing APIs; set resize cap, responder/view routes and visibility/focus; queue initial `Open`, resize, and scale events before returning. Close delegate always returns false and queues `CloseRequested`; app code decides, then explicitly destroys. Do not silently equate close callback with destruction.

**Geometry:** represent logical positions in finite top-left content-view points. Convert AppKit bottom-left local events exactly once at the view boundary. Keep precise pointer/scroll coordinates and deltas as `f64`, integer logical coordinates as rounded/clamped compatibility values, backing pixel extents separate from points and `scale`. For screen origin, port current NSScreen/CGDisplayBounds conversion in `platform_window_geometry.m`; reject missing screen/display or non-finite result. Check all multiplications/additions and bounds before casts. Preserve scale-change even when pixel extent is unchanged. Unit-test 1x/2x/3x, negative screen origins, rounding edges, overflow, missing display, and nonfinite input.

**Input and IME:** translate NSEvent modifier bits explicitly to accepted `vexel-ui` ordering (UI shift=1, command=2, option=4, control=8; C order differs). Emit distinct key down/up, pointer down/up/move, scroll and magnify values; retain key code, button, click count, timestamps, precise deltas and scale. `keyDown` calls `interpretKeyEvents`; implement complete `NSTextInputClient`: `insertText`, `setMarkedText`, `unmarkText`, `hasMarkedText`, `markedRange`, `selectedRange`, `validAttributesForMarkedText`, `attributedSubstringForProposedRange:actualRange`, `firstRectForCharacterRange:actualRange`, `characterIndexForPoint`, and `doCommandBySelector`. Composition carries owned marked UTF-8, selection/replacement ranges and attributes bounded to 64 KiB; convert AppKit UTF-16 `NSRange` to Rust UTF-8 offsets with checked scalar boundaries. Committed text is separate. Candidate rect maps content points to screen coordinates. Never infer committed text from `characters` or `charactersIgnoringModifiers`. UI `TextEdit` uses UTF-8 byte offsets; do conversion explicitly and preserve composition selection.

**Queue/ticks:** fixed total capacity 256, owned payload budget 1 MiB, single event payload/path limits above. Coalesce only adjacent compatible pointer-move/resize/scale events; never search backward across another event. Keep a 16-slot reserved control budget for key/button releases, close, focus-loss and queue-fault/reset. If capacity still exhausts, latch `QueueFault`, stop admitting ordinary input, deliver an explicit `InputReset`/all-buttons-and-keys-released state before further input, and latch close requests idempotently until acknowledged; no ignored enqueue failure. Poll drains at most caller's `max` (native dispatch itself at most 64 NSEvents per poll) and reports pending work so the caller can continue without starving other run-loop work. Use one removable per-window NSTimer/CFRunLoop source and generation route, not the legacy global raw pointer; wake main run loop on scheduling/queue changes. Timer callbacks emit owned `AnimationTick` monotonic timestamps and never mutate UI/model state.

**Foreign boundary:** wrap all objc2 message sends and every inbound protocol/delegate/block callback with `guard_native_call`; catch Rust unwind and objc2 `catch-all` translated message exceptions, return ABI-valid fallback and latch orderly failure. No unwind crosses an ABI callback. This guard does not cover raw C/CF calls, retain/release, destructor cleanup, or `panic=abort`; avoid them in callbacks or document unavoidable process termination. Never claim a universal foreign exception fence. Do not use `new_unchecked` MainThreadMarker or add first-party ObjC exception shims.

## Explicit later gates (not part of this order)

1. **File/open-save/drop/reopen/recents:** `platform_window_files.m`, internal file dispatch, path/extension/startup queue rules, NSOpenPanel/NSSavePanel, async sheet cancellation, file URL/drop security-scoped lifetime and recents storage. Must define accepted owned document/job APIs first; no path payload in this lane.
2. **Menus/commands/welcome:** `platform_window_menus.m`, native-shell menu/welcome functions, `platform_viewer_action`/command-state meaning, shortcut routing and state snapshots. Existing `CommandRegistry` is a seam, not complete menu parity.
3. **Accessibility:** full native AX tree/protocols, stable IDs/generations, screen-frame conversion, action routing and notifications over owned `SemanticsSnapshot`. UI snapshot alone is not VoiceOver support.
4. **Text/presenter:** CoreText shaping/outlines, `TextDraw` adapter, Metal layer/device/queue/pipeline/upload/present/readback and resource lifetime. Window view here is not a rendering/presentation claim.
5. **Dialogs/preferences/appearance:** error/unsaved/export choices, welcome/recent storage, system preferences/appearance subscriptions and cancellation/removal. Basic window appearance observation in this order is not full preferences parity.

## Acceptance evidence required when implemented

Focused tests: config limits/UTF-8/NUL; stable generation and stale-route rejection; geometry conversions and checked overflow; queue ordering/coalescing/barriers/capacity/reset/close under saturation; every key/button release survives or produces explicit reset; modifiers; timestamp monotonicity; UTF-16/UTF-8 IME ranges including surrogate pairs and replacement; composition commit/cancel/candidate bounds; callback panic/objc exception fallbacks; timer cancellation; repeated create/destroy and late callbacks. Build: macOS target `cargo check` for platform crate and focused test target, with existing pinned feature set only. Native boundary evidence: test harness/callback simulation without GUI launch, plus symbol/availability review against macOS 13 declarations. No test weakening.

Deferred manual/UI acceptance after downstream gates: launch on macOS 13 Apple Silicon; create/show/resize/move across displays and backing scales; close request/dirty decision; key press/release and pointer capture; real CJK/compose IME candidate placement and commit; wake/tick/stop under load; repeated shutdown with active callbacks; VoiceOver, menus, dialogs and actual presentation after their orders. Report exact host/OS and evidence. Planning work itself runs no build/test/GUI and makes no native runtime, macOS 13, or performance claim.

# Native window lane candidate

This candidate maps the preserved AppKit window shell into Rust-owned safe value APIs backed by opaque, main-thread-only native owners. Source evidence: `src/platform/platform_window.h`; `src/platform/macos/platform_window.m`, `platform_window_geometry.m`, `platform_window_animation.m`, `platform_window_files.m`, `platform_window_native_shell.m`, and `platform_window_internal.h`. Existing seams: `vexel_platform_apple::{MainThread,guard_native_call}`; `vexel_ui::{Rect,Tree,SemanticsSnapshot,TextEdit,WidgetCanvas,TextDraw}`. The exact function parity and bindings are in `parity-map.json`.

The ready order covers startup, windows, value geometry, event translation and bounded delivery, full IME, ticks, callbacks, and teardown. It names focused Rust tests/build checks and defers real GUI/manual acceptance. The queue must make overflow visible and synthesize explicit input reset/close state; release and close requests cannot disappear. Keyboard transitions stay distinct from committed and marked text.

Pinned bindings are already present in the audited crate: objc2 0.6.5, objc2-app-kit/Foundation/CoreFoundation/CoreGraphics/CoreText/Metal/QuartzCore 0.3.2, and block2 0.6.2. Selected declarations and exact local audit paths are linked in the map. Their existence in the current SDK/bindings is not macOS 13 runtime proof. Prefer baseline APIs; guard any newer symbol explicitly.

Independent gates remain mandatory: dependency/native-boundary ADR review; file/open-save/drop/reopen/recents; menus/commands; accessibility/VoiceOver; text shaping and presenter/Metal; dialogs/unsaved choices/preferences; then integrated manual GUI, IME, teardown, and macOS 13 acceptance. The new root kernel contract work is not a peer dependency of this lane. No native window, GUI, runtime, performance, build, or test completion is claimed.
WO-RUST-NATIVE-WINDOW-PLAN-01 candidate verification (read-only planning)

Read: OWNER-DIRECTIVES.md; AGENTS.md; frozen work/WO-RUST-NATIVE-WINDOW-PLAN-01.md; accepted artifacts/WO-RUST-NATIVE-PLAN-01/result.md; docs/product/rust-native-bindings-audit.md; binding pin/feature declarations in rust/crates/vexel-platform-apple/Cargo.toml; existing MainThread, guard_native_call, Rust UI geometry/input/tree/semantics sources; native window header, internal header, implementation, geometry, animation, files, shell and menus source; audited local binding symbol index/declarations.

Produced only: artifacts/WO-RUST-NATIVE-WINDOW-PLAN-01/result.md, parity-map.json, ready-window-order.md, verification.txt. Scope covers the declared public window API, native callbacks, geometry, queue, animation, file/shell/menu function disposition, accepted Rust seams and later gates. Candidate is implementation planning, not implementation.

No source/config/manifests/state/ledger/docs/orders/prior evidence modified. No build, test, network, install, dependency change, GUI, source fetch, agent, reset, stage, commit, or delete performed. No native window, GUI, macOS 13 runtime, or performance claim.

Limit: this record is a worker semantic/source coverage statement. Coordinator must independently audit the full parity map and protected baseline before freezing/recording any ready order.
